name: Sentry Release
description: GitHub Action for creating a release on Sentry

environment.description: Set the environment for this release. E.g. "production" or "staging". Omit to skip adding deploy to release.

inject.description: Injects Debug IDs into source files and sourcemaps. We strongly recommend enabling this to ensure proper un-minifaction of your stacktraces.

sourcemaps.description: Space-separated list of paths to JavaScript sourcemaps. Omit to skip uploading sourcemaps.

dist.description: Unique identifier for the distribution, used to further segment your release. Usually your build number.

finalize.description: When false, omit marking the release as finalized and released.

ignore_missing.description: When the flag is set and the previous release commit was not found in the repository, will create a release with the default commits count instead of failing th

ignore_empty.description: When the flag is set, command will not fail and just exit silently if no new commits for a given release have been found.

started_at.description: Unix timestamp of the release start date. Omit for current time.

version.description: Identifier that uniquely identifies the releases. Omit to auto-generate one.

set_commits.description: Specify whether to set commits for the release. Either "auto" or "skip".

projects.description: Space-separated list of projects. Defaults to the env variable "SENTRY_PROJECT" if not provided.

url_prefix.description: Adds a prefix to source map urls after stripping them.

strip_common_prefix.description: Will remove a common prefix from uploaded filenames. Useful for removing a path that is build-machine-specific.

working_directory.description: Directory to collect sentry release information from. Useful when collecting information from a non-standard checkout directory.

disable_telemetry.description: The action sends telemetry data and crash reports to Sentry. This helps us improve the action. You can turn this off by setting this flag.
